title: Infinite Ammo
script:
local Tables = {}

for i,v in next, getreg() do
    if typeof(v) == "table" then
        if v.Ammo then
            table.insert(Tables, v)
        end
    end
end

local function Upload()
    for i,v in next, Tables do
        v.Ammo = 10000
        v.StoredAmmo = 10000
        v.MagSize = 10000
        v.MaxAmmo = 10000
    end
end

while wait(15) do
    Tables = {}
   
    for i,v in next, getreg() do
        if typeof(v) == "table" then
            if v.Ammo then
                table.insert(Tables, v)
            end
        end
    end
   
    Upload()
end
